caption:
This strategy took me to $4k per day selling digital products that were generated by AI in under an hour.

The key is to analyze your competitors negative reviews to find hidden demand gaps, and creating products around those hooks. 

Follow for more tips on how to create and sell digital products online.
author: James Oreilly
transcript: I've been doing around $4,000 a day with a digital product that AI generated in under an hour. The cool thing is this is nothing technical and you don't have to be an expert in anything to make this work. In fact, here's the sales dashboard from the last two days so you can see my results. Now I've got three specific prompts that I use in order to accomplish this, and the first one is what I call complaint harvesting. You ask AI to find all of the top-selling products in your niche and then harvest all of the bad and negative reviews you can of those products. We're going to take all of those bad reviews and have AI analyze them to find what I call the hidden demand gap. The hidden demand gap is the most common pain point in all of those complaints and bad reviews that none of the products are addressing. We then ask AI to come up with solutions to that hidden pain point. And then in the third step, I use Canva AI specifically to create what I call the missing solution. I simply generate a digital product that teaches the solution we uncovered in the previous step. You now have a product that solves a problem no one else does. The product practically markets itself because it's the only solution to an in-demand problem. This prompt right here will get you started in finding those hidden demand gap pain points. Follow for more tips on not only how to create your own digital products, but how to sell them as well.
title: $4K/Day Using AI to Find Demand Gaps
one_liner: Use AI to mine competitor negative reviews, find unmet pain points, and create digital products that fill them.
key_points: 'Complaint harvesting': prompt AI to collect negative reviews of top-selling products in your niche
Identify the 'hidden demand gap' — the most common pain point none of those products address
Use Canva AI to generate a digital product offering the missing solution
Products built around unmet demand market themselves because they're the only solution to a real problem
